Welcome to Electrical Specialists!! 

We are an electrical contractor in the Kansas area specializing in residential service. We are always striving to stay ahead of the curve when it comes to code, technology, and best practices. We do our best to provide value by going in depth on issues pertaining to residential electrical applications. We love to answer questions so if there are any you have please leave them in the comments or email them to us at brandon@especialists.pro. Please like and subscribe to help us get this information out and help as many people as we can. Thank you for your support!
